# Pydantic Docs

> What is Pydantic and how it brings runtime validation to Python type hints

## Documentation

- [Introduction](/introduction.html): What is Pydantic and how it brings runtime validation to Python type hints
- [Installation](/installation.html): Install Pydantic via pip, uv, or poetry
- [Basic Usage](/basic-usage.html): Create your first Pydantic model and validate data
- [Models](/models.html): Define and configure Pydantic models with BaseModel
- [Fields](/fields.html): Field definitions with constraints, defaults, and metadata
- [Validators](/validators.html): Custom validation with field_validator and model_validator
- [Serialization](/serialization.html): Convert Pydantic models to dict, JSON, and custom formats
- [Configuration](/config.html): Model configuration with ConfigDict for behavior customization
- [String and Number Types](/strings-numbers.html): Pydantic field types for strings, numbers, and booleans
- [Date and Time Types](/dates.html): Date, time, datetime, timedelta, and duration field types
- [Collections and Mapping Types](/collections.html): List, set, dict, tuple, and other collection types in Pydantic
- [Unions and Optional Types](/unions-optionals.html): Union types, Optional, and nullable fields in Pydantic
- [Custom Types](/custom-types.html): Create custom field types, constrained types, and new type definitions
- [Generic Models](/generic-models.html): Create reusable generic models with type parameters in Pydantic
- [JSON Schema](/json-schema.html): Generate JSON Schema from Pydantic models
- [TypeAdapter](/type-adapter.html): Validate non-model types with TypeAdapter
- [Error Handling](/error-handling.html): Understanding and customizing Pydantic validation errors
- [Aliases](/aliases.html): Field aliases for JSON field name mapping
